# The Grand Underground

The tunnels under Sinnoh, with Hideaways full of wandering Pokémon. The place is the same in both versions; what lives there differs until you're the Champion, when each version's Hideaways get the other's Pokémon too: see the [Lustrous Pearl](wild-pokemon-pearl.md#grand-underground-hideaways) and [Adamant Diamond](wild-pokemon-diamond.md#grand-underground-hideaways) wild pages.

## Getting there

The Underground Man in Eterna City gives you the **Explorer Kit**. Use it from the Bag outdoors, not while surfing, to go down. To come back, use it again: you return to where you went down.

The tunnels are split into six parts that don't meet: you reach the one under where you went down. Going down somewhere else takes you to another. No bike, Fly or Escape Rope down here, and no wild Pokémon in the tunnels themselves.

## The Explorer Kit's menu

In the tunnels, Use opens DIGGER DRILL / GOODS / GO UP / CLOSE. The Digger Drill makes your [Secret Base](secret-bases.md), and can be used as often as you like. GOODS is your Bag of base goods.

## Hideaways

18 holes in the tunnel walls. Walk into one to go in. Inside, the Pokémon walk around: touch one for a battle. Every visit brings a new set. Once you have a [Secret Base](secret-bases.md), each new visit earns a Flag for it.

## Treasures

There's no digging in the walls in this game (no Sphere, trap or treasure hunting). What digging would have given comes in other ways:

- **Mysterious Shards:** once you're the Champion, a daily ball in Rocky Cave (Shard S), Dazzling Cave (Shard S), Big Bluff Cavern (Shard S) and Stargleam Cavern (Shard L). They trade for slates at [Pal Park](ramanas-park-pearl.md).
- **Fossils:** once you're the Champion, a daily ball in Rocky Cave and Sandsear Cave: at random Root Fossil, Claw Fossil, Helix Fossil, Dome Fossil, Old Amber, or the other version's fossil (the Skull Fossil in Lustrous Pearl, the Armor Fossil in Adamant Diamond), each one time in six. The version's own fossil comes from Hidden Grottos. The Oreburgh Mining Museum restores them into Pokémon.

## Hidden Grottos

Each Hideaway has a narrow path in a wall that leads to a Hidden Grotto. An empty grotto refills with a 5% chance every 256 steps you walk. It holds a Pokémon (level 25-29, with its Hidden Ability) or an item.

Which Pokémon: [Lustrous Pearl](wild-pokemon-pearl.md#hidden-grottos), [Adamant Diamond](wild-pokemon-diamond.md#hidden-grottos).

Items, by how often each kind of slot fills. Each grotto has its own four picks from each list:

| Chance | Items |
|---|---|
| 1% | a Plate (Flame Plate, Splash Plate, Zap Plate, Meadow Plate, Icicle Plate, Fist Plate, Toxic Plate, Earth Plate, Sky Plate, Mind Plate, Insect Plate, Stone Plate, Spooky Plate, Draco Plate, Dread Plate, Iron Plate), or a Heart Scale |
| 4% | the version's fossil (Armor Fossil in Lustrous Pearl, Skull Fossil in Adamant Diamond), Fire Stone, Water Stone, Thunderstone, Leaf Stone, Moon Stone, Sun Stone, Oval Stone, Everstone; or Star Piece, Rare Bone, Hard Stone, Light Clay, Damp Rock, Heat Rock, Icy Rock, Smooth Rock |
| 10% | Red Shard, Blue Shard, Yellow Shard, Green Shard; or Heart Scale, Red Shard, Blue Shard, Yellow Shard, Green Shard |
| 25% | Heart Scale |

## The Underground Man's missions

Talk to him in Eterna City between trips. His missions: go underground; make a Secret Base with the Digger Drill; decorate it; bring Flags. Rewards are on the [Secret Bases page](secret-bases.md). He has no digging or Sphere missions in this game.

Every battle in a Hideaway also counts for [Spiritomb](postgame-pearl.md#one-time-pokémon-of-the-story) in the Hallowed Tower on Route 209.
